row: Twin Boro Physical Therapy - New Jersey

Twin Boro is a growing and thriving manually-based private physical therapy practice with an emphasis on functional rehabilitation. We have been providing New Jersey residents with the highest quality rehabilitation services since 1980 and are the state’s largest private physical therapy practice with 27 locations in the Garden State.

The key to Twin Boro Physical Therapy’s success is a combination of highly skilled rehabilitation experts, state-of-the-art facilities and an outcome driven approach to getting patients back to full function. At Twin Boro, our team of physical therapists are comprised of compassionate, dedicated professionals committed to their patients.
